faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.intro: Have a question about a property or service? Call and speak directly with the inspection team.

items.q: How quickly will I receive my report?
items.a: CHI provides a detailed digital report with color photos, clear explanations and practical next steps within 24 hours.

items.q: Can I add radon, mold or water testing?
items.a: Yes. Add-on testing can be coordinated with your home inspection so you get a more complete picture in fewer appointments.
You are welcome to attend. It is a useful opportunity to see the home’s systems, ask questions and review the most important findings.

items.q: Do you work with real estate agents?
items.a: Yes. CHI works with buyers, sellers and agents and can share the completed report with the people you authorize.

items.q: How do I confirm service at my address?
items.a: Send the property address through the scheduling form or call 301-788-6608. We serve Maryland, Pennsylvania, DC and West Virginia.
